---
title: Why Typst matters
---

## Overview

Explore why Typst deserves a place on your radar, with concrete "quick wins" that show how it can dramatically simplify PDF generation.

{{< include _slides.md >}}

## Learning Objectives

By the end of this module, you will be able to:

* Render a Quarto document to PDF with `format: typst`, and style it with an existing brand.
* Explain how Typst differs from LaTeX-based PDF generation, and when each is the right choice.
* Read the intermediate `.typ` file to see how your content becomes a PDF, and to locate the source of an error.
* Write raw Typst blocks, using the Typst documentation to find the functions you need.
* Restyle a document with Typst set and show rules.
